title: Detailed kite
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- kite string -->
  <path d='M50 58 Q40 76 22 90' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- string bow 1 -->
  <path d='M42 70 l-5 -1 l2 4 z' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
  <path d='M42 70 l5 -1 l-2 4 z' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
  <!-- string bow 2 -->
  <path d='M30 81 l-5 -1 l2 4 z' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
  <path d='M30 81 l5 -1 l-2 4 z' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
  <!-- kite body: top half red, bottom half blue -->
  <path d='M50 8 L82 40 L50 40 Z' fill='#ff4d4d'/>
  <path d='M18 40 L50 40 L50 8 Z' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <path d='M18 40 L50 40 L50 72 Z' fill='#4dc3ff'/>
  <path d='M50 40 L82 40 L50 72 Z' fill='#3a86ff'/>
  <!-- spine and crossbar in light shades -->
  <line x1='50' y1='8' x2='50' y2='72' stroke='#fff4b0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='18' y1='40' x2='82' y2='40' stroke='#fff4b0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- side edges lighter -->
  <path d='M50 8 L18 40' stroke='#ffd9a0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 8 L82 40' stroke='#ffb3b3' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M18 40 L50 72' stroke='#bfeaff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M82 40 L50 72' stroke='#a9c8ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- decorative circles -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='30' r='4' fill='#fff4b0'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='30' r='4' fill='#fff4b0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='4' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M50 72 L44 84 L50 80 L56 84 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M50 80 L46 90 L50 86 L54 90 Z' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
</svg>
